philosophy: The asset adapts to the RECEIVING DCC, never the other way around. The sending side exports neutral: meters, Y-up, binary FBX. The receiver converts to its own conventions at import.

receiver_rule.container: Imported asset lands in a container EMPTY with t=0 r=0 s=1 at the world origin
receiver_rule.dimensions: Correct size is baked into the vertices (makeIdentity / transform_apply), never compensated by node scale
receiver_rule.oversize_policy: Meshes larger than 50 m are REPORTED, never auto-rescaled (no magic multipliers)
receiver_rule.unit_conversion: Done by geometry, not by a node

Unreal.units: centimeters (x100 from meters, import scale applied UE-side)

naming_idempotency: Apply Naming strips existing suffixes then adds the correct one — running it twice changes nothing. It always covers the selection AND its whole child branch (decision 2026-09-21).
export_presets: Use the list_presets tool for resolved settings: maya / houdini / ue / neutral. Per-call overrides merge over the preset and are echoed in the report.
render_output: Image files: PNG for previews, EXR for data (colorspace: data files raw, color files acescg).
notes: FBX exports include children of selected Empties automatically (children_recursive).
Use the render_offscreen tool for quick previews: mode viewport (fast OpenGL) or camera (scene engine).
Check API facts with get_bpy_api_info instead of guessing parameter names or enum values.
